result.final_text:
## What this letter says
Your blood test (HbA1c) was taken on 16 September 2026. The result was 58 mmol/mol.
An HbA1c test shows your average blood sugar over the last 2 to 3 months.
The letter asks you to keep taking your medicine metformin for now.
You have a review appointment. Your doctor will talk about a higher dose of metformin there. The dose has not been increased yet.

## What you need to do
1. Keep taking metformin 500 milligrams, twice a day, for now.
2. Do not take a higher dose yet. No increase has been made.
3. Go to your review on Monday 9 November 2026.

## Dates and medicines
- 16 September 2026: blood test (HbA1c) taken. Result: 58 mmol/mol.
- Monday 9 November 2026: review appointment. A higher dose of metformin will be talked about.
- Metformin: 500 milligrams, twice a day. Keep taking it for now.

## Questions to ask your doctor
- What does my HbA1c result of 58 mmol/mol mean for me?
- What is metformin and how does it work?
- What will we talk about at my review on 9 November 2026?

## When to get urgent help
The letter does not list specific warning signs.

If you are worried and it is not an emergency, call NHS 111. In an emergency, call 999.
